enabled.description: Enable the XML packet logging module. When disabled, no XML logging occurs.

log_dir.description: Directory where XML log files are stored. Must be writable by the ejabberd user.

log_file.description: Filename pattern for log files. Supports strftime directives like %Y, %m, %d, etc. for daily or hourly rotation.

max_size.description: Maximum size (in bytes) of a log file before it is rotated. Set to 0 to disable size-based rotation.

keep.description: Number of old log files to retain after rotation.

full_stanza.description: If true, log complete XMPP stanzas (including IQ, message, and presence). If false, log only metadata (e.g., JIDs, timestamps).

direction.description: Direction of traffic to log: 'in' (incoming to server), 'out' (outgoing from server), or 'both'.
